methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 11 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Octavia is a robotics and manufacturing company at an undisclosed stage. The available comp universe consists of one public peer (277810.KQ) and eight private companies in the robotics and manufacturing sector, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. This sparse and heterogeneous set presents significant constraints for valuation.

The peer-median method is not applicable. Despite identifying eleven same-sector peers, filtering for stage-aligned comparables yielded zero matches at Octavia's stage or adjacent stages, and zero within similar valuation tiers. The required minimum of three datapoints for a reliable median could not be met within any narrow peer cohort. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial noise given the wide dispersion in maturity, capital intensity, and business model across the broader robotics universe.

Without sufficient stage-matched or tier-matched precedent transactions or public trading multiples, traditional triangulation methods cannot support a defensible valuation range at this time. A credible analysis would require either: access to transaction data from more narrowly-defined peers, disclosure of Octavia's stage and capital structure to enable broader comp selection, or alternative methods (DCF with disclosed financials, or recent round pricing). Key uncertainties include Octavia's exact development stage, revenue traction, and capital requirements—all of which would materially influence appropriate comparable selection and valuation multiple.
